Bill.BriefDescription: Designating coffee as the state beverage.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating coffee as the state beverage; addinga new section to chapter 1.20 RCW; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that Washington iswell known as the espresso capital of the country. The coffee industryis a vital part of the Washington state economy that provides jobs andmorning motivation for many state citizens. Over half of the states inthe country have established a state beverage. The officialdesignation is a desirable promotional tool that Washington businessescan use when sharing their product with customers throughout the world.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Coffee is designated as the official beverage of the state ofWashington.
This act may be known and cited as the p. 1 HB 1715official Washington state beverage act.
